'''Imperial Informants''' were [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] citizens that were recruited to report on suspicious behavior. They didn't receive the same training as other Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and were just normal citizens that had been given some basic combat training. They wore plain clothes so that they could infiltrate crowds. They were also issued [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], although these were poorly concealed. Some were present on [[Sel Zonn Station]].
